title: 5 Phrases to Be More Professional at Work

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with (more professional than co-worker)
vocabulary.example: I'm having lunch with my colleagues.

vocabulary.meaning_en: behaving in a serious, skilled way at work
vocabulary.example: She always sounds very professional on the phone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make sure something is true or correct
vocabulary.example: I'd like to confirm the meeting time.
She solved the problem without confrontation.

vocabulary.note_en: Informal; don't say it to your boss.

vocabulary.example: My perspective is that we need more staff.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a short conversation to get or give an update
vocabulary.example: I just want to touch base about the project.
I did previously mention this problem.
How will you rectify this mistake?
How will we resolve this issue?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a problem or subject to deal with
vocabulary.example: We have an issue in the lunchroom.

vocabulary.meaning_en: confident and direct in a strong but polite way
vocabulary.example: Be assertive when you ask for a raise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: communication with your body, face and eyes, not words
vocabulary.example: A tilted head is non-verbal communication that shows you are listening.
This plan could be beneficial for the team.

fine_lines.title: I think / I'm not sure vs I believe / My perspective is
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في العمل، I think وI'm not sure تبدوان ضعيفتين وتقلّلان ثقة الآخرين بك. I believe وMy perspective is أقوى وتجعلك تؤخذ بجدية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: At work, "I think" and "I'm not sure" sound weak. "I believe" and "My perspective is" sound stronger, so people take you seriously.

examples.sentence: I think... maybe... we could try this? (weak)
I believe this plan will increase our profit. (strong)

fine_lines.title: touch base vs make sure we're on the same page
fine_lines.explanation_ar: touch base: حديث قصير وسريع للتحديث. on the same page: التأكد من أننا نفهم الأمر بالطريقة نفسها، وقد يحتاج شرحًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Touch base: a short, quick update. On the same page: making sure we both understand the same thing; may need more explanation.

examples.sentence: Can I touch base with you for two minutes?
Let me explain again so we're on the same page.

expressions.phrase: I want to make sure we're on the same page.
expressions.meaning_ar: أريد التأكد من أننا متفقان في الفهم.
expressions.meaning_en: I want to check we understand each other.
expressions.example: Before we start, I want to make sure we're on the same page.

expressions.meaning_en: a soft way to ask someone to fix a problem without confrontation
expressions.example: Mr. E, I need your help. There's a problem in the lunchroom.

expressions.meaning_en: strong ways to give your opinion
expressions.example: My perspective is that we should hire two more people.

expressions.phrase: I just want to touch base.
expressions.meaning_ar: أردت فقط أن أتواصل معك سريعًا.
expressions.example: I just want to touch base about the report.

expressions.phrase: I did previously mention that this might happen. How will you resolve this issue?
expressions.meaning_ar: سبق أن ذكرت أن هذا قد يحدث. كيف ستحلّ المشكلة؟
expressions.meaning_en: a professional way to say "I told you so" and ask for a solution
expressions.example: I did previously mention the risk. How will you resolve this issue?

expressions.phrase: Don't say: I told you so.
expressions.meaning_en: This sounds rude in English-speaking workplaces.
expressions.example: Instead of "I told you so", say "I did previously mention..."

questions.question: Mr. E keeps cooking fish in the office microwave. Which phrase avoids confrontation?
questions.explanation_ar: I need your help تدعوه للمساعدة دون صدام.
questions.explanation_en: "I need your help" invites him in without a fight.

questions.question: Mr. E looks confused after your explanation. You say:
choices: I want to make sure we're on the same page.
questions.explanation_ar: on the same page للتأكد من الفهم المشترك.

questions.question: You warned him, and now there's a problem. The professional way is:
choices: I did previously mention this might happen. How will you resolve it?
questions.explanation_ar: هذه طريقة مهنية بدل I told you so.
questions.explanation_en: This is the polite version of "I told you so".

questions.question: You want to be taken seriously. Start with:
questions.explanation_ar: I believe أقوى من I think.

questions.question: Your boss is busy; you want a very short update meeting. You say:
"Colleague" is a more professional word for:
When you say "I did previously mention...", James suggests you should then ___.
choices: stay quiet and let them answer

questions.question: Which sentence should you NOT say at work?
questions.explanation_ar: I told you so تبدو وقحة.
